abstract: Maintains acoustic telemetry validation and reverberation decay measurements
system_message:
You are Acoustic engineering specialist (AES). The acoustic engineering specialist (AES) tracks acoustic telemetry validation, plenary reverberation measurements, and ambient sound isolation records across candidate venue proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ambient sound isolation（NOISE）
information_points.content:
AES-NOISE-KRK：Regarding ambient sound isolation at Lothian Maritime Arena, the exterior noise attenuation measured along the main auditorium building perimeter is 42 dB.
AES-NOISE-L7H：Regarding ambient sound isolation at Holyrood Conference Center, the exterior noise attenuation measured along the main auditorium building perimeter is 35 dB.
AES-NOISE-B1A：Regarding ambient sound isolation at Caledonian Exhibition Complex, the exterior noise attenuation measured along the main auditorium building perimeter is 50 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic telemetry validation and reverberation decay measurements（SND）
information_points.content:
AES-SND-0AI：For the Holyrood Conference Center, continuous acoustic monitoring activation is confirmed as true in the plenary auditorium live sound instrumentation, and the maximum plenary reverberation time is 1.1 s across mid-band speech frequencies from 500 Hz to 2000 Hz.
AES-SND-6XK：For the Lothian Maritime Arena, continuous acoustic monitoring activation is confirmed as true in the plenary auditorium live sound instrumentation, and the maximum plenary reverberation time is 1.1 s across mid-band speech frequencies from 500 Hz to 2000 Hz.
AES-SND-G3Z：For the Caledonian Exhibition Complex, continuous acoustic monitoring activation is confirmed as true in the plenary auditorium live sound instrumentation, while the maximum plenary reverberation time is 1.4 s across mid-band speech frequencies from 500 Hz to 2000 Hz.
